shared_elements: repeated rows of small vertical strokes or figures
justification: Both surfaces show human figures organized into horizontal registers, and both include rows of repeated small strokes/figures (the crew strokes on the boats in B, the seated attendants in A), but this is a generic organizing convention rather than a shared motif. A depicts a detailed offering-type scene with seated figures on chairs, a table with vessels, and columns of script signs, while B is dominated by boats with upturned prows and crew-strokes plus isolated stick figures — the two share no specific creature, object or attribute.
